purpose: Coverage-first measurement of the first non-pass task in the fixed 189-task development ledger under the unchanged current generic candidate.
change_scope: No task-driven code change. Measure the unchanged generic candidate on the first non-pass ledger task using a fresh VM and immutable result directory.

implementation_evidence.parent_diagnosis: v78 found all six files, read the workbook, and invoked the PDF reader correctly. The matching PDFs were scanned and yielded no usable embedded text; Qwen then searched for image text extraction, but no OCR action existed, tried the PDF reader on JPG files, and stopped within the eight-event no-progress window.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual_scope: Unit and clean-VM tests use museum labels, city transit notices, public maps, and unrelated scan directories. They vary file structure and text, exercise both PNG and PDF sources, and contain no Order 98 task ID, workbook name, receipt filename, transaction value, answer row, or evaluator state.
implementation_evidence.clean_vm_dependency_probe: Fresh Ubuntu guest initially had pdftoppm and pdftotext but not tesseract. A bounded apt install of tesseract-ocr plus tesseract-ocr-eng succeeded without guest proxy in 20.731 seconds.
implementation_evidence.clean_vm_action_probe: Deployed the current OS Adapter to a fresh guest. First image.extract_text_batch call installed OCR in 20.720 seconds, read one synthetic PNG and one synthetic scanned PDF, returned exact expected English text for both, passed 2/2 path verifier checks, and completed in 26.193 seconds.
implementation_evidence.focused_tests: 431 passed before the full suite; covers image/PDF OCR, bounded text, per-file status, nested-directory recovery, strict OS and Multi-Apps schemas, unchanged flat forwarding, catalog recall/deduplication, compact result context, verifier behavior, and read-only classification.
implementation_evidence.ruff: changed active source and tests passed lint and format checks
implementation_evidence.osworld_evaluator_tree: frozen commit with zero tracked evaluator changes

protocol.on_failure: Preserve and audit the untouched baseline, classify the failure, and do not rerun it unchanged. Try at most three materially different generic hypotheses with one targeted A/B each. If all three fail, mark the task task_blocked and immediately advance to the next ledger entry.

selection.method: first non-pass in the task-ID-deduplicated development coverage ledger
